name: Child's pose
summary: From kneeling, sit the hips back onto the heels and reach the arms forward along the floor.
setup: Kneel on a mat side-on to the phone at floor level. Sit back toward the heels and walk the hands forward until the forehead is near the floor. Breathe into the back and hold.
brief: Kneel on a mat. Sit back toward the heels and walk the hands forward until the forehead is near the floor, then breathe into the back and hold.
why: From the side the knee is fully folded while you sit back, so the timer runs only while the hips are actually down.
tempo: Ease in over a breath; hold.
progression: Walk the hands to one side to stretch the flank.
regression: A cushion between the calves and the hips.
contraindications: Knee pain when folding; pregnancy after the second trimester.

faults.label: Hips coming up
faults.tip: If the hips hover, put a cushion behind the knees so you can rest rather than hold.

faults.label: Shoulders up around the ears
faults.tip: Let the arms be heavy; the reach comes from the hips going back.

faults.label: Knees too close together
faults.tip: Widening the knees lets the chest sink between the thighs and the lower back open.

faults.label: Shallow breathing
faults.tip: Long breaths into the back ribs are what make this position release.
